When the admin appends "a" to the "Назва" field
Then the Team category "Назва" value should be "a" with the correct counter
When the admin appends "b" to the "Назва" field

When the admin appends "c" to the "Назва" field
Then the Team category "Назва" value should be "abc" with the correct counter
When the admin removes the last character from the "Назва" field
Then the Team category "Назва" value should be "ab" with the correct counter
When the admin removes the last character from the "Назва" field
Then the Team category "Назва" value should be "a" with the correct counter
